title: Chapter 2721: Fighting the Invader
content:
Chapter 2721: Fighting the Invader

A few hours after the invaders slipped through the crack in the barrier, the one heading toward Gaia’s Heaven finally reached the city.

However, it did not enter the city and instead hovered just beyond the walls.

The soldiers of Gaia’s Heaven had been prepared for its arrival long beforehand, and the moment it appeared, they swiftly surrounded it.

Since the invader wasn’t in the city, some soldiers had to surround it from the outside, but they weren’t worried their large numbers would attract the Void Hunter, since they were still too close to the city walls.

"T-That’s what the invaders look like...?"

The soldiers swallowed nervously when they finally saw the invader’s appearance for the first time, clear discomfort written across their faces.

The invader had a human figure—or at least something that vaguely resembled one. However, it possessed six limbs: four arms and two legs.

It had a head, but no facial features whatsoever. Its face was completely smooth, and its scalp was entirely bald. Its skin was a uniform, unnatural white, as if it had been coated in paint, giving the creature an eerie, unsettling appearance.

Although no one had truly expected the invaders to look exactly like the ones they had faced during the drills, none of them could have imagined just how terrifying the real thing would be.

Simply looking at the entity sent chills down their spines, even weakening their will to fight.

Of course, its appearance wasn’t the only reason. An unfathomable aura surrounded it, radiating a strange energy none of them had ever encountered.

"What are you? And what is your purpose here?" One of the Midnight Squad soldiers questioned the invader.

"..."

Unsurprisingly, the invader remained silent.

"..."

The soldiers didn’t dare make the first move, either.

After all, they still didn’t know the entity’s true purpose—or whether it was truly an invader in the first place.

However, that doubt was shattered in an instant when the invader suddenly unleashed its energy, killing more than a hundred soldiers in the blink of an eye.

"A-Attack!" someone shouted.

The soldiers immediately retaliated, bombarding the invader with their Limitless.

Yet, despite the barrage, the invader didn’t even flinch.

When the attacks finally subsided a minute later, the invader remained completely unscathed.

"N-No way... How are we supposed to fight a monster like this?!"

"Where is Captain Yuan?!"

"Get back! We’ll take it from here!" A woman’s voice suddenly resounded across the battlefield.

The moment the soldiers heard her voice, a wave of relief washed over them.

A moment later, Ironwoman stepped forward and confronted the invader. But she wasn’t alone, and several Midnight Squad soldiers accompanied her.

Ironwoman’s aura erupted as she unleashed her full cultivation and struck at the invader.

This time, however, the invader didn’t simply stand there and take the attack. Instead, it moved to evade it.

The second the invader evaded Ironwoman’s attack, the Midnight Squad soldiers swiftly followed up, striking it with their weapons.

However, their weapons couldn’t even leave a scratch on the invader’s leather-like skin, much less injure it.

"What the hell?! How are we supposed to fight a monster like this when even high-grade weapons don’t work on it?!"

"It must be that weird energy surrounding it!"

"Keep trying! I refuse to believe it’s invincible!"

But no matter how many times they struck it with their weapons, the invader remained completely unfazed.

In fact, it ignored them entirely, acting as if they didn’t even exist, its blank face fixed on Ironwoman as though it were contemplating something.

After several minutes of complete stillness, the invader finally moved.

It lunged at Ironwoman with all four arms extended, its hands curled into claw-like shapes as though it intended to capture her.

Ironwoman gritted her teeth and fought back with everything she had, unleashing her full strength without the slightest reservation, as though her life depended on it.

Unfortunately, even with her overwhelming prowess, Ironwoman’s attacks proved completely ineffective against the invader.

Just as the invader was about to reach her, another presence suddenly appeared and struck it from behind, sending it crashing into the ground with a heavy thud.

Ironwoman turned to look at this individual and immediately smiled behind her mask.

"General Mei!"

It wasn’t just Mei Feng, either. General Gu also appeared a second later.

"Where’s Yuan?" Mei Feng asked.

"I don’t know."

"Damn it! Not even the Supreme General knows where he went!" Mei Feng gritted her teeth in frustration.

"How could he disappear without a word at such a crucial time?!"

"I bet you he never intended to help us," General Gu remarked with a cold sneer. "Hell, I wouldn’t be surprised if he was working with the invaders!"

"Save your nonsense for later, General Gu."

Supreme General Tian arrived at the scene with a deep frown, his gaze locking onto the invader, which had already risen back to its feet without a single scratch on its body.

"This isn’t an opponent we can leave to the ordinary soldiers. We’d only be sending them to their deaths."

Although it was far from ideal, Supreme General Tian realized that if they wanted even the slightest chance of defeating the invader, all of their strongest fighters would have to work together from the very beginning.

"I can’t believe we’re already reaching this stage..." General Gu said, shaking his head.

"And there’s only one of them right now..." Mei Feng bit her lip so hard that it began to bleed.

"Get ready!" Supreme General Tian shouted as the invader leaped back into the air, then flew at Ironwoman again.

"It’s going for Ironwoman again!"

"Don’t look down on me!" Ironwoman roared as her aura suddenly flared, becoming so intense that it was visible to the naked eye, flickering around her body like a veil of flames.

She then activated a martial technique, unleashing a wave of flames that engulfed the invader in a sea of fire.

"?!?!"

However, a moment later, Ironwoman’s eyes widened in bewilderment as she watched the invader absorb the flames directly through its skin, devouring every last trace until not even the faintest flicker remained.
